A skilled Senior Full Stack Developer is needed to work in a high performing agile squad  within the Technology & Transformation division. Your role is to build Web applications, API or microservice capabilities in support of key strategic initiatives all aimed at uplifting our Digital Insurance capabilities.
You will be an active contributor to the Agile software development lifecycle and be familiar with DevOps/Continuous Integration and production deployment processes. The role will also include leading systems analysis, design, development, maintenance & ongoing support to ensure that the quality of the solutions and artefacts you produce meet the defined needs relative to Suncorp’s environment.
What You’ll Do
Lead design, development and implementation of consistent guidelines and frameworks that build quality, automation and security into Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration pipelines
Provide technical leadership in designing and implementing automation, Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration, config management and monitoring practices in teams across portfolio
Provide guidance and feedback for delivery teams to implement best practices and operational requirements such as high availability, disaster recovery and security compliance
Analyse system requirements and develop technical design
Design, Develop and maintain Digital applications
Perform unit and integration testing on developed code including the execution of thorough and effective unit and system test plans and participate and/or support further testing phases
What You’ll Bring
Full stack development expertise including previous working experience in a senior role (i.e. 5+ years’ experience leading/mentoring engineering teams)
Strong programming skills and technical knowledge of ReactJs, Java, Spring Boot, Gradle/Maven, Jenkins, Openshift, AWS
Experience supporting high availability production systems
Experience in employing CI/CD techniques in utilising Serverless computing concepts and container platforms (ideally AWS and/or Openshift)
Experienced in source code management, configuration management, build and dependency management tools, web frameworks, API frameworks & testing frameworks
What You’ll Enjoy
Access our award-winning Shine platform – your central hub for exclusive perks, wellbeing support, career development, and recognition. Shine has been recognised for excellence in employee experience, making it easier than ever to access what matters most to you.
Hybrid working, flexible leave, 20 weeks paid parental leave, and up to 5 days paid flexible leave annually
Paid study support, career breaks, on-the-job learning, and a $1,000 referral bonus
Free wellbeing coaching, a dedicated Employee Council, and confidential EAP access
Discounts at 400+ retailers, insurance savings, gym memberships, and reduced super fees
Paid volunteer leave, donation matching, and unlimited emergency response leave
Performance-based bonuses and Suncorp shares for eligible employees
Diversity is celebrated through employee resource groups and inclusive policies for all families
Explore our full benefits: www.suncorpgroup.com.au/careers/benefits
At Suncorp we believe we are our best when our workforce is as diverse, talented and passionate as the communities in which we live and operate, and where our people feel included, valued and connected. We are passionate about inspiring our people by creating a diverse, accessible, and inclusive culture, offering flexible work, career development and internal mobility, and building connected relationships amongst our team members and with our customers.
If you require any support and adjustments to participate equitably in our recruitment process or in the workplace, we encourage you to contact
